title: Rhea Care Resident Qualification
objective: Qualify the repo-proven Rhea/Care system against current OTHRYS V2 evidence, Work, Talos, Prometheus, Mnemosyne and Hephaestus contracts before any House admission.
laws: Rhea is Care, not a fourth Triad office and not Kronos.
Care may observe, assess, case-manage, coordinate, verify and watch; it never owns Life, scheduling, engineering, credentials, research, memory or approval authority.
Care failure must not stop the Triad or the system.
Consequential repair must stop at current authority gates; Rhea cannot approve or apply its own repair.
Current Talos, Work, Prometheus, Mnemosyne and Hephaestus are reused, never duplicated.
Old Hub state stores, schedulers, alert engines and UI are not transplanted without separate proof.
PandaOS contributes experience patterns only; no care backend authority.
